technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with golden cross and new highs, but overbought conditions and bearish intermediate/long-term structure limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: EFX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 90 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (2 buys, 1 sale) from junior members with small amounts, neutral market sentiment (AAII 47% bearish, Fear/Greed 47), and no recent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (275.36) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event imminent (0 days), and macro score of -6 reflects deteriorating conditions; earnings in 90 days adds execution risk but falling DXY provides modest relief for multinationals.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with new 20-day highs and force index confirmation provide short-term momentum entry signal with defined support at 159.44.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought technicals (RSI 78, Stoch 86), price below 200-EMA, bearish intermediate structure (EMA 20/50 and 50/200), zero fundamental conviction, and macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 275, CPI event imminent) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: EMA 9/21 golden cross with new 20-day highs provides short-term momentum, but overbought RSI (78) and stochastic (86) at resistance levels create poor risk/reward entry geometry.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 275, CPI event imminent) combined with price below 200-EMA and bearish intermediate structure create high probability of mean reversion into support, invalidating swing thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 65 positions in Industrials sector; adding EFX increases concentration risk without fundamental or macro justification.
